item.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
item.description: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
item.description: The attack on funeral at a Greek Orthodox church killed nine and injured 34 others last month.

item.title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
item.description: Both Hamas and IDF officials confirm the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

item.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
item.description: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

item.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
item.description: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.

item.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
item.description: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.

item.title: Judo champion shakes up French presidential race with surprise candidacy
item.description: Teddy Riner is one of the most popular figures in modern-day France, and one in five voters say they could support him.

item.title: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion?
item.description: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity.
